glasses_dana: Previous notes suggested coffee_table_l1 for late evening, but today at 20:54 it was at bed_b1. Combined with earlier data (07:00 bathroom_shelf_ba1, 13:07 coffee_table_l1), the location is highly unpredictable and does not follow a strict time-of-day pattern. Do not rely on time-based heuristics. Check bathroom_shelf_ba1, coffee_table_l1, desk_o1, nightstand_b1, and bed_b1 as primary candidates, but be prepared for it to be in any of these locations regardless of the hour.

mug_dana: Previous notes incorrectly assumed kitchen_table_k1 for morning and late evening. Today’s feedback confirmed the mug was at desk_o1 during the workday (09:02, 13:58). This suggests the mug stays at the office desk while Dana is working (9:00–17:30). Check desk_o1 for all daytime hours (09:00–17:30). Re-evaluate evening locations separately, as the 20:48 coffee_table_l1 data point may still be valid for post-work hours, but do not apply kitchen_table_k1 to morning or midday.

water_bottle_dana: Highly mobile; location depends on time of day. Previous notes indicated desk_o1 for midday and late night. However, today at 13:05 (afternoon), it was found at dish_rack_k1, and at 19:22 (evening), it was found at kitchen_table_k1. This suggests that during the afternoon and evening, the bottle is more likely to be in the kitchen rather than the office. Check dish_rack_k1 and kitchen_table_k1 for afternoon and evening locations.

book_dana: Previous notes assumed nightstand_b1 or couch_l1, but today at 20:54 it was at bed_b1. This contradicts the earlier assumption that it moves to the couch for evening reading. Check bed_b1 for evening locations, as Dana may read in bed rather than on the couch.
